QGIS 4.2.2 can enable WAL when subset filters are changed on cloned GeoPackage layers, invalidating existing NOLOCK readers and changing the database journal header. Reproduced on isolated copies at about 321 open handles (limit 1048575). True provider forceReadOnly flags prevent the transition; the build also fixes OGR_SQLITE_JOURNAL=DELETE within its process. Both corrected probes preserved SHA256 and all feature counts.

QGIS 4.2.2 stores absolute fallback sources in layout Layer attributes despite relative project storage. The builder normalizes these saved XML attributes and checks copied-layout pixel identity at 72 dpi.
